modal.help_s1b: Waylu Diskeji ngam volums timmuɗi, + Ɓeydu dosiye ngam ɓeydude, x ina itta gooto, walla njaar `;`-seertaaɗe laawoli e Edit. Waylugol toɓe ina wayla dosiyeji.
modal.help_s2b: Innde, Regex (sintaks Rust), Fuzzy, Maqal fiijirde, Glob (*.rs), Gootol-heen (OR) / Alaa-heen (NOT), mawnugol (bytes walla 10M/1G), ñalɗi (YYYY-MM-DD), doggol Riiw, Extensions walla chips kuppe (lomta, kaɓɓu kadi ngam momtude; Yam ina wayla aadaaji), Yejjit mawni binndi, Hollo suuɗiiɗe.
modal.help_s3b: Buton mawɗo Scan & search walla Enter. Hesɗitin ina rutta e jogaade suɓngo. Live ina rutta wayle kusa (ɗum uddaa e fuɗɗoode). Yiylooje mehre njaɓataa — huutor * e Glob ngam fop.
modal.help_s4b: Tiitoonde tokosere ina rente, Go ina yaha e heese, checkboxes ina njamina Naggit laawoli / Dillu / Momtu e exports CSV–TXT–HTML–Excel–RTF. Yiylooje mooftaaɗe e Recent ina rutta filto kala ina heen dosiyeji, OR/NOT, e suuɗiiɗe.
